description: Discriminator: with the recovering replica holding only a default record for (1,0) and a peer reporting the instance COMMITTED at vbal 0, does the recovery adopt the committed vector or restart phase 1? Prefix: the peer's record is prepared as COMMITTED with a real PUT command; the recovering replica's record is a default NONE record; the peer's real PrepareReply is delivered through the real wire form. Controls: the same harness also prints the seed state (lb.ballot and the self VBallot) and which message the recoverer emits next, so an unreached prerequisite is visible rather than silent.

harness.description: In-package Go test building two real Replica values and delivering Prepare/PrepareReply through their real Marshal/Unmarshal form.

legality.derivation: The obligation follows from the role of recovery in EPaxos: the value that could have been committed is the one with the highest vbal among a slow quorum, and a reply reporting COMMITTED is authoritative for the instance. The harness fixes the recovering replica's record as a default NONE record so the only value in the history is the peer's committed vector.
legality.applicability: N=3, Thrifty, IsLeader false, one COMMITTED reply and one local default record; the recovery is entered directly through startRecoveryForInstance.
unresolved: whether a full legal history (proposal, accept round, commit broadcast, execution timeout) reaches the same state
whether the launched configuration permits the recovering replica to be in that state at all

semantic_changes: harness-only scaffolding: two Replica values are constructed in-package instead of through New(), per-peer buffers replace the TCP transport, and the recovery is entered directly through startRecoveryForInstance instead of the execution timeout; all protocol messages still travel through the real Marshal/Unmarshal form and all decisions are made by the unmodified handlers

prepared history: the peer's record for the instance is installed as COMMITTED with a real PUT command and the recovering replica's record is a default NONE record, because the check discriminates the resolution step rather than the proposal round that produced the commit

grounding.derivation: The resolution event is the completed recovery decision for the instance: it records whether the committed vector was adopted, the resulting local status and which message the recoverer emitted.
grounding.applicability: Resolution reached with the prerequisite reply present for the same instance identity.

observable_properties.description: A completed recovery resolution in which a reply reported the instance COMMITTED must adopt that committed vector.

uncertainties: The harness prepares the peer's COMMITTED record directly; a full history is not constructed.
Only the resolution decision is observed, not the later accept round or execution.
